{{CharInfobox| color={{fire color}}| corecolor={{fire color light}}| bordercolor={{flying color dark}}| name=Liza| jname=ジーク| tmname=Sieg| text=white| slogan=no| image=Liza Best Wishes.png| size=250px| caption=Liza in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'' flashback | colors=yes| eyes=Blue| hair=Green| gender=Female| hometown=Unknown| region=[[Johto]]| trainer=yes| trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}}| game=no| leader=no| team=no| brain=no| anime=yes| epnum=EP134| epname=Charizard's Burning Ambitions| enva=[[Lisa Ortiz]]| java=Sakiko Tamagawa| }} '''Liza''' (Japanese: '''ジーク''' ''Sieg'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is the caretaker of the [[Charicific Valley]], which was made specifically as a natural paradise for {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Charizard}}. ==History== [[File:Liza.png|thumb|left|220px|Liza in her debut]] ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|GS}}==== Liza debuted in ''[[EP134|Charizard's Burning Ambitions]]''. She knew of a {{pkmn|Trainer}}'s victory at the [[Violet Gym]] with a Charizard, and immediately deduced that that Trainer was {{Ash}}, as she can identify Charizard Trainers by the lingering scent of their Charizard partner. She invited Ash and {{ashfr}} to come with her into the valley, encouraging Ash to ride his {{AP|Charizard}} as transport, somewhat questioning why—as a Charizard Trainer—he had never {{m|Fly|flown}} upon his (even though when Ash originally got Charizard to obey him in ''[[EP105|Charizard Chills]]'', he also flew on it). She also questioned the strength of Ash's Charizard, indicating only 'weak' Charizard display their power through Charizard's typical {{m|Flamethrower|stream of fire}}, and that it needed some serious training. Charizard wanted to train at the valley seeing the other powerful {{p|Charizard}} there, but Liza initially refused after it lost to her Charizard, [[Charla]]. But after seeing its determination to train there, she agreed. Liza made a brief cameo appearance in ''[[M03|Spell of the Unown: Entei]]'' with Charla and all of the other Charizard in the Charicific Valley. She could be seen watching the news coverage of the events unfolding in [[Greenfield]]. In ''[[EP253|Great Bowls of Fire!]]'', Liza brought [[Ash's Charizard]] with her. It was revealed that she was good friends with [[Clair]] ever since they were young children. Liza often takes the Charizard from the Charicific Valley to [[Blackthorn City]] in order to {{pkmn|training|train}} them. In ''[[EP254|Better Eight Than Never]]'', Liza watched Ash's [[rematch]] against Clair. She later left Blackthorn City, taking Charizard back to the Charicific Valley for further training. Ash would also call Liza sometimes whenever he needed Charizard sent over, as seen in ''[[EP269|The Ties that Bind]]'', ''[[AG135|Numero Uno Articuno!]]'', and ''[[AG189|Gathering the Gang of Four!]]''. ===={{aniseries|BW}}==== Liza appeared in a flashback in ''[[BW116|The Fires of a Red-Hot Reunion!]]'', again with Charla and all of the other Charizard in the Charicific Valley. She sent Ash's Charizard to {{an|Professor Oak}} off-screen, so he could send it to the [[Unova]] region. Charizard went on to travel with Ash through the [[Decolore Islands]], and since ''[[BW142|The Dream Continues!]]'', it now resides at [[Professor Oak's Laboratory]]. ==Character== Liza is a confident and tough {{p|Charizard}} {{pkmn|Trainer}} who enjoys the responsibility of being the [[Charicific Valley]] caretaker. She is competitive and likes to push the Charizard of Charicific Valley to their limits. Liza's blunt advice and rough trials eventually led [[Ash's Charizard]] to reconsider his ambitions and confidence in his abilities. Her training strategy relies on mutual respect. Though she is fully aware of a Charizard's power, she does not accept misbehavior and aggression. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Liza's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {| width="100%" |- | {{ActivePoké|Liza|Charizard|Liza Charla.png|fire|flying|nick=Charla}} ♀ | | | |} ===Training=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Liza |pkmn=Charizard (multiple) |type1=Fire |type2=Flying |img=Liza Charizard.png |img2=Liza Charizard Best Wishes.png |cap=Liza's other Charizard |cap2=Liza's other Charizard as seen in Best Wishes! |epnum=EP134 |epname=Charizard's Burning Ambitions |desc=Liza trains multiple {{p|Charizard}} that live at [[Charicific Valley]]. They are wild, and never see humans because of the risk of [[Pokémon hunter|Pokémon poachers]]. The Charizard battle and train to become stronger. She first showed them to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, where they saw some of them battling, some of them sleeping, and some doing other activities. One [[Giant Pokémon|large]] Charizard walked up to {{OP|Ash|Charizard}}, and Liza pointed out that if he could defeat this Charizard, he could live in the valley. Ash's Charizard was initially unsuccessful, but he eventually joined the group of Charizard at the end of the episode. It was revealed in ''[[EP253|Great Bowls of Fire!]]'' that she often takes Charizard to [[Blackthorn City]] in order to train them.
